transcript.en: Hello, West Bay Hotel. Can I help you?
transcript.zh: 你好，西海湾酒店，我能帮你做什么

transcript.en: Oh, good morning. I'm ringing about your advertisement in the Evening Gazette.
transcript.zh: 早上好，我打电话是为了你们在《Evening Gazette》上登的广告

transcript.en: Is that the one for temporary staff?
transcript.zh: 招临时工的那个吗

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 是的

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: I'm afraid the person who's dealing with that isn't in today, but I can give you the main details if you like.
transcript.zh: 恐怕负责人今天不在，但是如果你乐意，我可以为你介绍一些主要的内容，

transcript.en: Yes please. Could you tell me what kind of staff you're looking for?
transcript.zh: 好的，你能告诉我你们在招哪种员工吗

transcript.en: We're looking for waiters at the moment. There was one post for a cook, but that's already been taken.
transcript.zh: 我们现在正在招服务生有一个厨师的岗位，不过已经有人了。

transcript.en: Oh right. Erm, what are the hours of work?
transcript.zh: 好的工作时间是什么

transcript.en: There are two different shifts - there's a day shift from 7 to 2 and a late shift from 4 till 11.
transcript.zh: 有两种不同的班，早班是7点到两点，晚班是4点到11点。

transcript.en: And can people choose which one they want to do?
transcript.zh: 员工可以选择自己想上哪一种吗

transcript.en: Not normally, because everyone would choose the day shift I suppose. You alternate from one week to another.
transcript.zh: 通常不能，因为我认为每个人都想选择早班，每周轮换一次

transcript.en: Okay. I'm...I'm just writing all this down. What about time off?
transcript.zh: 好的，我把这些都记下来了，关于休息日呢

transcript.en: You get one day off and I think you can negotiate which one you want, it's more or less up to you. But it has to be the same one every week.
transcript.zh: 你有一天的休息，我认为你可以协商选哪天休。这或多或少取决于你，但是必须每周都是同一天。

transcript.en: Do you know what the rates of pay are?
transcript.zh: 你知道薪水是多少吗

transcript.en: Yes, I've got them here. You get ￡5.50 an hour, and that includes a break.
transcript.zh: 是的，我这里有，每小时5.50英镑，包括一个短暂的休息时间，

transcript.en: Do I have to go home to eat or...
transcript.zh: 我得回家吃饭还是……

transcript.en: You don't have to. You can get a meal in the hotel if you want to, and there's no charge for it so you might as well.
transcript.zh: 你不必，如果你愿意，你不妨在酒店吃一顿饭，而且是免费的。

transcript.en: Oh good. Yes, so let's see.
transcript.zh: 很好，是的，让我看看

transcript.en: I'd get...er, two hundred and twenty one, no, two hundred and thirty one pounds a week?
transcript.zh: 221磅，不是，是231英镑

transcript.en: You'd also get tips - our guests tend to be quite generous.
transcript.zh: 你还能收到小费，我们的客人通常很大方。

transcript.en: Erm, is there a uniform? What about clothes?
transcript.zh: 有制服吗，服装怎么样

transcript.en: Yes, I forgot to mention that. You need to wear a white shirt, just a plain one, and dark trousers.
transcript.zh: 是的，我忘了说了，你得穿白衬衫，普通的那种，深色的裤子，

transcript.en: You know, not green or anything like that. And we don't supply those.
transcript.zh: 不能是绿色或类似这种的颜色，我们不提供这些

transcript.en: That's okay, I've got trousers, I'd just have to buy a couple of shirts.
transcript.zh: 没关系，我有裤子，我只需买几件衬衫。

transcript.en: What about anything else? Do I need a waistcoat or anything?
transcript.zh: 其他的事情呢，我需要马夹或其他什么吗

transcript.en: You have to wear a jacket, but the hotel lends you that.
transcript.zh: 你得穿外套，不过酒店会借给你。

transcript.en: I see. Er, one last thing - I don't know what the starting date is.
transcript.zh: 我明白了，最后一件事，我不知道开始日期是几号。

transcript.en: Just a minute, I think it's sometime around the end of June. Yes, the 28th, in time for the summer.
transcript.zh: 稍等。我想时间是在6月底左右。，是的，在夏季的28日。

transcript.en: That's great. I'm available from the 10th.
transcript.zh: 好极了，我从10号开始就有空了

transcript.en: Oh good.
transcript.zh: 很好

transcript.en: Well, if you can call again you need to speak to the Service Manager.
transcript.zh: 如果你再打来电话，你需要找服务经理，

transcript.en: Her name's Jane Urwin, that's U-R-W-l-N, and she'll probably arrange to meet you.
transcript.zh: 她叫简·厄温，拼写是U-R-W-I-N，她可能会安排与你见面。

transcript.en: Okay. And when's the best time to ring?
transcript.zh: 好的，什么时候打电话最合适

transcript.en: Could you call tomorrow?
transcript.zh: 明天可以吗

transcript.en: Um, she usually starts checking the rooms at midday, so before then if you can, so she'll have more time to chat.
transcript.zh: 她通常在中午开始检查房间，所以如果可以的话在此之前打来，这样她有更多的谈话时间。

transcript.en: I'll just give you her number because she's got a direct line.
transcript.zh: 我把她的电话给你，她有直线电话

transcript.en: Thanks.
transcript.zh: 谢谢

transcript.en: It's 832 double-0 9.
823 double-0 9?
Oh, okay. Yes, I'll do that.
transcript.zh: 好的，我会打的

transcript.en: And by the way, she will ask you for a reference, so you might like to be thinking about that.
transcript.zh: 顺便说一下，她会问你要推荐信，所以你可以想一想，

transcript.en: You know, just someone who knows you and can vouch for you.
transcript.zh: 就是有人了解你并能为你做担保

transcript.en: Yes, no problem. Well, thanks very much for your help.
transcript.zh: 好的，没问题，非常感谢你的帮助，

transcript.en: You're welcome. Bye.
transcript.zh: 不客气，再见

transcript.en: Bye.
transcript.zh: 再见
